name: @gobye/api
description: GoBye backend API (NestJS on Fastify). Phase 1 foundation: health, config, auth, permissions, database, migrations, jobs, provider interfaces.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc-alias -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.test: rm -rf dist-test && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc-alias -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test --test-reporter=spec --test-concurrency=1 'dist-test/apps/api/test/**/*.test.js'
